_comment: Donation methods shown on the site. Leave a value empty to hide that method. URLs must start with https://. PIX: the key plus the receiver's name and city (the QR code and copy-and-paste code are made from them; bank apps show the account holder from the PIX key itself). qr: link methods that also show a QR code, each with what the code holds (empty: the link itself; PayPal's own QR adds &source=qr).
